# AI Development Instructions

This application uses Vue 3, Vite, and JavaScript.

- Use Vue 3 Composition API (`<script setup>`).
- Keep code clean, modular, and beginner-friendly.
- Use JavaScript instead of TypeScript.
- Preserve existing functionality when making changes.
- Make the application fully responsive for mobile and desktop screens.
- Explain important code changes clearly before implementing them.
- Verify changes by ensuring the project builds successfully (`npm run build`).
